Rafael Nadal vs Roger Federer - Semi-final Highlights | Roland-Garros 2019. Watch the best moments from the semi-final that opposed Rafael Nadal and Roger Federer at 2019. Rafael Nadal won 6/3; 6/4; 6/2.
These highlights were brought to you by Emirates.
This is the official YouTube Channel of Roland Garros, home of the French Open. The tournament 2019 will run from 20 May - 09 June.
